lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: So I can't use the helmet for the tournament.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Can you come up with a workaround?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Think you can pull off a do-rag?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I mean, I can try.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: So, what do you think, Trunks?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I think if I'm honest, Mom will ground me.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Probably.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Well, if it isn't the Great Saiyaman, gracing us with his presence.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Having fun using our name for your stupid superhero bullshit?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Vegeta, did you take out the trash like I asked?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Why? We have slaves for that.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Stop calling them slaves!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Fine. Interns.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Hey Vegeta, you taking part in the World Martial Arts Tournament too?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Why? So I can beat up a bunch of weaklings for money? I'm already rich and I've got nothing to prove.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: What if I was there?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh no, the voices are back.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: No, I'm real.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey King Kai, am I real?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Oh yeah, no, he's real.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Not according to that court-ordered quack!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Actually, I hear him too.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: What the hell?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Heaven, actually.
